label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/sql-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is a dynamically constructed SQL query containing user-provided param from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest'). The SQL string 'UPDATE accounts SET note='' + param + '' WHERE id=1' is built via string concatenation with unsanitized user input. Although execution occurs outside this method, storing the maliciously craftable SQL query in request attributes enables injection when retrieved/executed downstream. This is a genuine SQL injection vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') concatenated directly into SQL query string without sanitization or parameterization
